coin.vsBtc: TRX moves unlike most alts: it topped with BTC in Nov 2021 and bottomed with it in Nov 2022, but then trended up through 2023–24, topped on 3 Dec 2024 and recovered most of its 2025 drop while BTC fell.
coin.behave: TRX's periods are dated from TRX's own tops and bottoms (top 15 Nov 2021, bottom 17 Nov 2022, top 3 Dec 2024, low 16 Mar 2025). Binance TRXUSDT data here starts in May 2021, so there is one past bear to compare (2021–22).
